summary.text: On Ulgrotha, a plane ruined by the Wizards' Wars, Feroz arrives and marries Serra, and together they work to restore the land and create Feroz's Ban to guard it from planeswalkers.

When Feroz dies in a lab accident, the grief-stricken Serra is manipulated by Baron Sengir into leaving the plane, so the Ban begins to fail and the civilizations fight each other while Sengir plots to take control.

Elsewhere on the plane, young Jared Carthalion swears vengeance on Ravidel for the murder of his parents and destroys Castle Melmereth with a Shivan Dragon, and Gull and Greensleeves build an army against the wizard Towser.
